name: Austin Aries
aka: The Greatest Man That Ever Lived
caption: A wrestler of the AEW's 2015 roleplay pages: billed 'THE GREATEST MAN THAT EVER LIVED' in his own roleplay, eliminated from the Wrestle War match by Goldust and then booked on Monday Night Concussion against Luke Bryan, his sheet naming The Miz as tag partner and the Brainbuster as finisher.

portrays.note: The fed's own roleplay pages stage this character under the real performer's own name, per the per-promotion portrayal rule.

identity.note: An exact name match across other promotions' own portrayals of the same real performer. Each is filed as its own per-promotion row, never merged, and linked only through the shared external-figures record (austin-aries-real).

name: Miss Tessmacher
caption: A figure of the AEW's 2015 roleplay pages: 'ONE SEXY SECRETARY' to Austin Aries in his Monday Night Concussion roleplay, fetching his food and screening the interviewer.

name: Renee Young

name: Luke Bryan
caption: A wrestler of the AEW's 2015 roleplay pages: left the Wyatt Family for the Sons of Sandow at Wrestle War per the Aries roleplay, and is booked against Austin Aries on Monday Night Concussion.

name: Kevin Owens
caption: A wrestler of the AEW's 2015 roleplay pages: named as Austin Aries's first-round opponent in the sixteen-man Road to Superclash and, in Steve Corino's roleplay, as a former protege of Corino's now under Paul Heyman's wing.
